title: Deliver Medical Report to Colonel Cabo
description: Deliver Medical Report to Colonel Cabo — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Colonel Cabo

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Deliver the approved medical report to Colonel Cabo in the MutantMania Training Center.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Colonel Cabo

Repeatable: No

Zone: Mutant Mania

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Deliver the approved medical report to Colonel Cabo in the MutantMania Training Center.

Offer:

Ohhh, yes, this snot sure did the trick. Through a complete examination of its goodness, I can't find any proof of any cheating.

Take this extra-special report back to Colonel Cabo in the MutantMania Training Center and you can get back to work. I can't wait to see you back in the ring!

My name is Doctor Whom the Eleventh, and I approve this report.

Turn-in:

Listen up friend, Ah can't handle scares like that. Make sure you keep to the straight and narrow. Well, straight-enough, that is.

Objectives:

  • Positive Medical Report ×1

Level range: 88–100
